description: Save where a worker starts the day (their home or a yard), or with no person_id the shop's yard, used when a worker has none. Owner or office for anyone; a worker for themselves. A worker's own start is seen only by them and the owner or office.

label.description: A short name, for example "Shop yard" or "Home".

lat.description: Latitude in decimal degrees (WGS 84), for example 43.6150.

lng.description: Longitude in decimal degrees (WGS 84), for example -116.2023.

source.description: agent when your tools looked it up (default), typed when a person typed it in.

name: routes_setStart
